note: SPEC-49 CI-1/CI-2/CI-4 · SHRINK-ONLY (C70 §5.3). Every row is a SWEEP CASE exhibiting its row's defect CLASS, measured by DRIVING the real production entry — not by reading a file. Keyed `<CLASS>::<generator>::<sweep-case>` with CLASS ∈ { DOORLESS · UNREACHABLE · CORRIDOR-STAIR-GAP · CORRIDOR-HALL-GAP } — NEVER by room name (the engine may legitimately re-mint a name) and NEVER by a bare count (a count lets one fix and one new break cancel out and read as no change, C70 §5.5). Checked in BOTH directions: an UNLEDGERED finding exits 3, and a row here that is no longer measured also exits 3 — strike it in the commit that pays it, never in a later tidy-up. THE RE-PIN RULE: the only legal edit is DOWNWARD — strike rows as fixes land; a NEW finding is fixed in the offending commit, never added here. Raising this file to go green is forbidden outright (C70 §5.3 / R7): a measurement raised becomes a permission. Rows were pinned AT the executed reading of their pin date, never above it (C73 §3.4 — a ratchet above its own reading is free slots).

whatTheRowsHaveInCommon: BATHROOMS DOMINATE CI-2, and that is consistent by construction rather than coincidence: §DOOR-RESCUE-REACH deliberately EXCLUDES wet rooms from its rescue pass (SPEC-CIRCULATION-GRAPH §9.5 — they are owned by the privacy passes), so a landlocked bathroom has no rescuer.

HOUSE IS AN ORDER OF MAGNITUDE WORSE THAN APARTMENT on the SAME engine and the SAME door router. The difference is one fewer refusal: `isHousePath = input.envelopeValidator !== undefined` is always true for a house storey, and the empty-result branch is guarded `if (viable.length === 0 && !isHousePath)`. A house storey must always produce a layout (SPEC-49 §3 item 2).
FOUR CI-2 ROWS ARE A DOORLESS `Stair` — a storey whose VERTICAL CIRCULATION ELEMENT has no opening at all. SPEC-49 §1 CI-2 names this the most severe form. These should be the first four struck.

EVERY apartment CI-1 row is also a CI-2 row for the SAME plate — in the apartment sweep unreachability IS doorlessness (SPEC-49 §2 fact 2: the failure is 'no door was ever emitted', not 'a bad spine strands a well-doored room'). The house sweep breaks that identity: five house CI-1 rows name rooms (`r5`, `r7`) that are NOT in any doorless set — genuinely stranded-behind-a-bad-spine, CI-1's own failure shape.

FIVE house CI-1 rows name a RAW ROOM ID (`r5`, `r7`) where every other row names a room. The engine's own verdict carries ids un-renamed for these rooms — itself a finding about the naming pass; SPEC-49 §7 records the reachability predicate as duplicate-name LATENT-unsafe, and these rows are where that latency is nearest the surface.

CI-4 SPLITS CLEANLY BY STOREY: both CORRIDOR-HALL-GAP rows are GROUND floors (F0, corridor fails to meet the entrance hall) and all six CORRIDOR-STAIR-GAP rows are UPPER floors (F1, corridor fails to meet the stair) — every 2-storey house plate except 10x8 exhibits at least one. The upper-storey corridor is not seated against the vertical circulation it exists to serve.

RESIDENTIAL HAS NO ROWS IN ANY CLASS, and that is an AFFIRMATIVE measurement over 34 shipped units, not an absence of data — 34/34 carried a CI-0 verdict. A blended 'the generators are ~20% broken' would have been true of nothing and would have pointed the fix at the wrong generator.

exitCondition: ALL THREE class arrays reach 0 — every case in the three committed sweeps ships every room with at least one realised opening, BFS-reaches every room from the entrance, and seats every corridor against its origin — at which point this gate flips hard-0 and its gate-newly-measured.json entry is struck. The cheapest first move is the four DOORLESS `Stair` rows: a doorless vertical-circulation element is the most severe form of CI-2 and is unlikely to need the product decision the bathroom rows may (§DOOR-RESCUE-REACH's wet-room exclusion is DELIBERATE, so closing those rows means deciding who rescues a landlocked wet room). Fixing an apartment DOORLESS row is expected to strike its paired UNREACHABLE row in the SAME commit — the shrink-only check will demand it (a paid row left behind exits 3 STALE).
